===== app/api/pixel/capi-status/route.ts =====
// app/api/pixel/capi-status/route.ts
// Admin-only. Hanya mengembalikan ya/tidak apakah token CAPI terpasang — nilai token TIDAK pernah dikirim.
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { verifyAdminRequest } from '@/lib/adminAuth'
import { getCapiToken } from '@/lib/metaCapi'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  if (!(await verifyAdminRequest(req))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tidak diizinkan' }, { status: 401 })
  }

  const ids = (req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('ids') || '')
    .split(',')
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter((s) => /^\d+$/.test(s))
    .slice(0, 20)

  const configured: Record<string, boolean> = {}
  for (const id of ids) configured[id] = getCapiToken(id) !== null

  return NextResponse.json({ configured })
}

===== app/api/pixel/test/route.ts =====
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto'
import { verifyAdminRequest } from '@/lib/adminAuth'
import { sendCapiEvent, SITE_URL } from '@/lib/metaCapi'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
const NS = { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' }

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  if (!(await verifyAdminRequest(req))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Sesi admin tidak valid. Login ulang lalu coba lagi.' }, { status: 401, headers: NS })
  }
  let body: Record<string, unknown> = {}
  try { body = await req.json() } catch { /**/ }

  const pixelId  = String(body.pixelId  || '').trim()
  const token    = String(body.token    || '').trim()
  const testCode = String(body.testCode || '').trim()

  if (!/^\d+$/.test(pixelId))          return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Pixel ID tidak valid.' }, { status: 400, headers: NS })
  if (!/^\S{20,600}$/.test(token))     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Conversion API Token belum diisi atau tidak valid.' }, { status: 400, headers: NS })
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}$/.test(testCode)) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Kode Testing belum diisi atau tidak valid.' }, { status: 400, headers: NS })

  const ip = (req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || '').split(',')[0].trim()
  const userData: Record<string, unknown> = { client_user_agent: req.headers.get('user-agent') || 'Journalyze-Admin-Test' }
  if (ip) userData.client_ip_address = ip

  const result = await sendCapiEvent(pixelId, token, {
    eventName: 'PageView',
    eventId: `test_${randomUUID()}`,
    sourceUrl: `${SITE_URL}/`,
    userData,
  }, testCode)

  if (!result.ok) return NextResponse.json({ error: `Meta menolak: ${result.error}` }, { status: 502, headers: NS })

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, events_received: result.eventsReceived ?? 0, fbtrace_id: result.fbtraceId ?? '-', test_event_code: testCode }, { headers: NS })
}

===== components/PixelTracker.tsx =====
'use client';

// components/PixelTracker.tsx
// Dipasang SEKALI di app/layout.tsx. Menjalankan aturan Meta Pixel dari admin:
//  - trigger "Halaman dibuka"  → saat path berubah
//  - trigger "Elemen diklik"   → satu listener klik global
//  - trigger "Scroll"          → listener scroll per halaman
// Trigger "tombol bayar" & "pembayaran sukses" dipanggil dari halaman /order & /checkout.
// /admin tidak pernah dilacak.
// Mode uji coba: tambahkan ?pixel_debug=1 di URL untuk melihat log event di layar
// (?pixel_debug=0 untuk mematikan).

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  clearPixelDebug,
  getActiveAnalytics,
  getCachedPixelConfig,
  getPixelConfig,
  getPixelDebugEntries,
  initPixel,
  isExcludedPixelPath,
  isPixelDebugOn,
  pathMatches,
  runPixelTrigger,
  setPixelDebug,
  subscribePixelDebug,
} from '@/hooks/usePixel';
import type { PixelDebugEntry } from '@/hooks/usePixel';

function clickMatches(target: Element, selector: string): boolean {
  try {
    const s = selector.trim();
    if (s.toLowerCase().startsWith('text:')) {
      const needle = s.slice(5).trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!needle) return false;
      const el = target.closest('a,button,[role="button"],input[type="submit"]');
      if (!el) return false;
      const text = (el.textContent || (el as HTMLInputElement).value || '').toLowerCase();
      return text.includes(needle);
    }
    return !!target.closest(s);
  } catch {
    return false; // selector tidak valid → abaikan
  }
}

/* ── Overlay uji coba ── */

const EMPTY_ENTRIES: PixelDebugEntry[] = [];
const getServerEntries = () => EMPTY_ENTRIES;

function DebugOverlay({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const entries = useSyncExternalStore(subscribePixelDebug, getPixelDebugEntries, getServerEntries);

  const time = (ts: number) => {
    try {
      return new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString('id-ID', { hour12: false });
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        left: 12,
        bottom: 12,
        width: 'min(400px, calc(100vw - 24px))',
        maxHeight: '45vh',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        background: 'rgba(10,10,10,0.96)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.5)',
        borderRadius: 10,
        boxShadow: '0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
        zIndex: 2147483000,
        fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace",
        fontSize: 11,
        color: '#F8F4EC',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          gap: 8,
          padding: '8px 12px',
          borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.25)',
        }}
      >
        <strong style={{ color: '#E8C567', letterSpacing: 1 }}>🧪 PIXEL DEBUG</strong>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
          <button
            onClick={clearPixelDebug}
            style={{ background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid #444', color: '#C8C0B0', borderRadius: 6, padding: '2px 8px', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 11 }}
          >
            Bersihkan
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{ background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid #444', color: '#C8C0B0', borderRadius: 6, padding: '2px 8px', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 11 }}
          >
            ✕ Tutup
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ overflowY: 'auto', padding: '6px 12px 10px' }}>
        {entries.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ color: '#6A6050', padding: '8px 0' }}>
            Belum ada event. Buka halaman lain, klik, atau scroll sesuai aturan.
          </div>
        ) : (
          entries.map((e) => (
            <div key={e.id} style={{ padding: '6px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'baseline' }}>
                <span style={{ color: e.kind === 'fired' ? '#22C55E' : '#E8C567' }}>{e.kind === 'fired' ? '●' : '○'}</span>
                <span style={{ color: '#6A6050' }}>{time(e.ts)}</span>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{e.text}</span>
              </div>
              {e.detail && (
                <div style={{ color: '#8A8070', marginLeft: 14, wordBreak: 'break-all', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>{e.detail}</div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PixelTracker() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const firedPathRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const [debugOn, setDebugOn] = useState(false);

  // ── Mode uji coba: baca ?pixel_debug= (harus dideklarasikan lebih dulu agar aktif sebelum event pertama) ──
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const flag = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('pixel_debug');
      if (flag === '1') setPixelDebug(true);
      else if (flag === '0') setPixelDebug(false);
    } catch {
      // abaikan
    }
    setDebugOn(isPixelDebugOn());
  }, []);

  // ── Klik: satu listener global, aturan dibaca dari cache saat klik terjadi ──
  useEffect(() => {
    const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const cfg = getCachedPixelConfig();
      if (!cfg || getActiveAnalytics(cfg).length === 0) return;

      const path = window.location.pathname;
      if (isExcludedPixelPath(path)) return;

      const target = e.target as Element | null;
      if (!target || typeof target.closest !== 'function') return;

      const ids = new Set<string>();
      for (const rule of cfg.rules) {
        if (!rule.enabled || rule.trigger !== 'click' || !rule.selector) continue;
        if (!pathMatches(rule.pages, path)) continue;
        if (clickMatches(target, rule.selector)) ids.add(rule.id);
      }
      if (ids.size > 0) runPixelTrigger('click', undefined, (r) => ids.has(r.id));
    };

    document.addEventListener('click', onClick, true);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('click', onClick, true);
  }, []);

  // ── Halaman dibuka + scroll: jalan tiap path berubah ──
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    let cancelled = false;
    let removeScroll: (() => void) | undefined;

    // setTimeout 0 supaya efek halaman (mis. setPixelContext) selesai lebih dulu
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      const path = window.location.pathname;
      if (isExcludedPixelPath(path)) return;

      const cfg = await getPixelConfig();
      if (cancelled) return;

      // Cegah kirim ganda untuk path yang sama (mis. React StrictMode di dev)
      if (firedPathRef.current === path) return;
      firedPathRef.current = path;

      initPixel(cfg);
      runPixelTrigger('page_load');

      // Aturan scroll untuk halaman ini (hanya jika ada analitik aktif)
      if (getActiveAnalytics(cfg).length === 0) return;
      const scrollRules = cfg.rules.filter(
        (r) => r.enabled && r.trigger === 'scroll' && pathMatches(r.pages, path)
      );
      if (scrollRules.length > 0) {
        const fired = new Set<string>();

        const check = () => {
          const doc = document.documentElement;
          const scrollable = doc.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
          // Halaman yang tidak bisa di-scroll dianggap belum mencapai kedalaman apa pun
          const pct = scrollable <= 0 ? 0 : (window.scrollY / scrollable) * 100;

          const due = scrollRules.filter(
            (r) => !fired.has(r.id) && pct >= (r.scrollPercent ?? 50)
          );
          if (due.length > 0) {
            due.forEach((r) => fired.add(r.id));
            const ids = new Set(due.map((r) => r.id));
            runPixelTrigger('scroll', undefined, (r) => ids.has(r.id));
          }
        };

        window.addEventListener('scroll', check, { passive: true });
        removeScroll = () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', check);
        check();
      }
    }, 0);

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (removeScroll) removeScroll();
    };
  }, [pathname]);

  if (!debugOn || isExcludedPixelPath(pathname || '')) return null;

  return (
    <DebugOverlay
      onClose={() => {
        setPixelDebug(false);
        setDebugOn(false);
      }}
    />
  );
}

===== hooks/usePixel.ts =====
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { _sb } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TIPE
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

export type PixelTriggerType =
  | 'page_load'        // halaman dibuka
  | 'click'            // elemen diklik (selector CSS atau text:Teks)
  | 'scroll'           // scroll mencapai X%
  | 'pay_click'        // tombol bayar diklik (dipanggil dari /order & /checkout)
  | 'payment_success'; // pembayaran sukses (dipanggil dari /order & /checkout)

export type PixelValueMode = 'none' | 'fixed' | 'auto';

// Jenis analitik. Saat ini hanya Meta Pixel; jenis lain tinggal ditambah di sini.
export type PixelAnalyticsType = 'meta_pixel';

export interface PixelAnalytics {
  id: string;
  type: PixelAnalyticsType;
  name: string;
  pixelId: string;
  testCode?: string;       // opsional (data lama); Kode Testing sekarang disimpan di localStorage admin
  enabled: boolean;
}

export interface PixelRule {
  id: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  event: string;            // nama event Meta (standar atau custom)
  pages: string;            // pola halaman dipisah koma: "/upgrade, /order", "/blog/*", "*"
  trigger: PixelTriggerType;
  selector?: string;        // untuk trigger 'click'
  scrollPercent?: number;   // untuk trigger 'scroll' (1-100)
  valueMode: PixelValueMode;
  value?: number;           // untuk valueMode 'fixed'
  contentName?: string;
  targets?: string[];       // id analitik tujuan; kosong/undefined = semua analitik aktif
}

export interface PixelConfig {
  analytics: PixelAnalytics[];
  rules: PixelRule[];
}

export interface PixelContextData {
  value?: number;
  content_name?: string;
  eventId?: string;       // deduplikasi dengan Conversion API (mis. order_id)
}

declare global {
  interface Window {
    fbq: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
    _fbq: unknown;
  }
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   KONSTANTA
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

export const STANDARD_EVENTS: string[] = [
  'PageView',
  'ViewContent',
  'Search',
  'AddToCart',
  'AddToWishlist',
  'InitiateCheckout',
  'AddPaymentInfo',
  'Purchase',
  'Lead',
  'CompleteRegistration',
  'Contact',
  'Subscribe',
  'StartTrial',
  'SubmitApplication',
  'Schedule',
  'CustomizeProduct',
  'Donate',
  'FindLocation',
];

const TRIGGERS: PixelTriggerType[] = ['page_load', 'click', 'scroll', 'pay_click', 'payment_success'];
const VALUE_MODES: PixelValueMode[] = ['none', 'fixed', 'auto'];
const ANALYTICS_TYPES: PixelAnalyticsType[] = ['meta_pixel'];

const TRIGGER_NAMES: Record<PixelTriggerType, string> = {
  page_load: 'Halaman dibuka',
  click: 'Elemen diklik',
  scroll: 'Scroll halaman',
  pay_click: 'Tombol bayar diklik',
  payment_success: 'Pembayaran sukses',
};

// Aturan awal — sama dengan perilaku tetap sebelumnya.
// Catatan: /home dialihkan (redirect) ke "/", jadi halaman utama dicocokkan lewat "/".
export const DEFAULT_PIXEL_RULES: PixelRule[] = [
  { id: 'r_pageview', enabled: true, event: 'PageView', pages: '/', trigger: 'page_load', valueMode: 'none' },
  {
    id: 'r_viewcontent',
    enabled: true,
    event: 'ViewContent',
    pages: '/upgrade, /order',
    trigger: 'page_load',
    valueMode: 'auto',
    contentName: 'Journalyze Premium',
  },
  {
    id: 'r_initiatecheckout',
    enabled: true,
    event: 'InitiateCheckout',
    pages: '/order, /checkout',
    trigger: 'pay_click',
    valueMode: 'auto',
  },
  {
    id: 'r_purchase',
    enabled: true,
    event: 'Purchase',
    pages: '/order, /checkout',
    trigger: 'payment_success',
    valueMode: 'auto',
  },
];

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PARSING
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function cloneDefaults(): PixelRule[] {
  return DEFAULT_PIXEL_RULES.map((r) => ({ ...r }));
}

export function parsePixelRules(raw: string | undefined): PixelRule[] {
  // Key belum ada → pakai aturan awal. Array kosong yang valid → memang tanpa aturan.
  if (raw === undefined || raw === null || raw === '') return cloneDefaults();
  try {
    const arr: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return cloneDefaults();

    const out: PixelRule[] = [];
    for (const item of arr) {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
      const o = item as Record<string, unknown>;

      const event = typeof o.event === 'string' ? o.event.trim() : '';
      if (!/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,49}$/.test(event)) continue;

      const trigger = o.trigger as PixelTriggerType;
      if (!TRIGGERS.includes(trigger)) continue;

      const pages = typeof o.pages === 'string' ? o.pages.trim() : '';
      if (!pages) continue; // aturan tanpa halaman diabaikan (jangan jadi "semua halaman")

      const valueMode: PixelValueMode = VALUE_MODES.includes(o.valueMode as PixelValueMode)
        ? (o.valueMode as PixelValueMode)
        : 'none';

      const rule: PixelRule = {
        id: typeof o.id === 'string' && o.id ? o.id : `r_${out.length}_${event}`,
        enabled: o.enabled !== false,
        event,
        pages,
        trigger,
        valueMode,
      };

      if (typeof o.selector === 'string' && o.selector.trim()) rule.selector = o.selector.trim();
      if (typeof o.scrollPercent === 'number' && Number.isFinite(o.scrollPercent)) {
        rule.scrollPercent = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Math.round(o.scrollPercent)));
      }
      if (typeof o.value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(o.value) && o.value >= 0) rule.value = o.value;
      if (typeof o.contentName === 'string' && o.contentName.trim()) {
        rule.contentName = o.contentName.trim().slice(0, 100);
      }
      if (Array.isArray(o.targets)) {
        const t = o.targets.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string' && x.length > 0);
        if (t.length > 0) rule.targets = t;
      }

      out.push(rule);
    }
    return out;
  } catch {
    return cloneDefaults();
  }
}

/**
 * Daftar analitik. Jika key 'pixel_analytics' belum ada, otomatis dimigrasi dari
 * pengaturan lama (pixel_id + pixel_enabled) supaya Pixel yang sudah tersimpan tidak hilang.
 */
export function parsePixelAnalytics(
  raw: string | undefined,
  legacyPixelId?: string,
  legacyEnabled?: boolean
): PixelAnalytics[] {
  if (raw === undefined || raw === null || raw === '') {
    const id = (legacyPixelId || '').trim();
    if (/^\d+$/.test(id)) {
      return [{ id: 'a_legacy', type: 'meta_pixel', name: 'Meta Pixel', pixelId: id, enabled: !!legacyEnabled }];
    }
    return [];
  }
  try {
    const arr: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];

    const out: PixelAnalytics[] = [];
    for (const item of arr) {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
      const o = item as Record<string, unknown>;

      const type = o.type as PixelAnalyticsType;
      if (!ANALYTICS_TYPES.includes(type)) continue;

      const pixelId = typeof o.pixelId === 'string' ? o.pixelId.trim() : '';
      if (!/^\d+$/.test(pixelId)) continue;

      const name = typeof o.name === 'string' && o.name.trim() ? o.name.trim().slice(0, 60) : 'Meta Pixel';

      out.push({
        id: typeof o.id === 'string' && o.id ? o.id : `a_${out.length}_${pixelId}`,
        type,
        name,
        pixelId,
        enabled: o.enabled !== false,
        ...(typeof o.testCode === 'string' && o.testCode.trim() ? { testCode: o.testCode.trim().slice(0, 40) } : {}),
      });
    }
    return out;
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function getActiveAnalytics(cfg: PixelConfig): PixelAnalytics[] {
  return cfg.analytics.filter((a) => a.enabled && /^\d+$/.test(a.pixelId));
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CONFIG — cache di level module
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

let cachedConfig: PixelConfig | null = null;
let configPromise: Promise<PixelConfig> | null = null;

export function getCachedPixelConfig(): PixelConfig | null {
  return cachedConfig;
}

export function getPixelConfig(): Promise<PixelConfig> {
  if (cachedConfig) return Promise.resolve(cachedConfig);
  if (configPromise) return configPromise;

  configPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await _sb
        .from('settings')
        .select('key, value')
        .in('key', ['pixel_id', 'pixel_enabled', 'pixel_analytics', 'pixel_rules']);
      if (error) throw error;

      const get = (k: string): string | undefined =>
        data?.find((r: { key: string; value: string }) => r.key === k)?.value;

      const cfg: PixelConfig = {
        analytics: parsePixelAnalytics(get('pixel_analytics'), get('pixel_id'), get('pixel_enabled') === 'true'),
        rules: parsePixelRules(get('pixel_rules')),
      };
      cachedConfig = cfg;
      return cfg;
    } catch {
      // Gagal fetch: jangan di-cache supaya bisa dicoba lagi
      return { analytics: [], rules: [] };
    } finally {
      configPromise = null;
    }
  })();

  return configPromise;
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODE UJI COBA (debug) — log event di layar lewat ?pixel_debug=1
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

export interface PixelDebugEntry {
  id: number;
  ts: number;
  kind: 'fired' | 'info';
  text: string;
  detail?: string;
}

let debugEntries: PixelDebugEntry[] = [];
let debugSeq = 0;
const debugListeners = new Set<() => void>();

export function isPixelDebugOn(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    return window.sessionStorage.getItem('pixel_debug') === '1';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function setPixelDebug(on: boolean) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    if (on) window.sessionStorage.setItem('pixel_debug', '1');
    else window.sessionStorage.removeItem('pixel_debug');
  } catch {
    // abaikan
  }
}

function debugLog(kind: 'fired' | 'info', text: string, detail?: string) {
  if (!isPixelDebugOn()) return;
  debugEntries = [{ id: ++debugSeq, ts: Date.now(), kind, text, detail }, ...debugEntries].slice(0, 50);
  debugListeners.forEach((l) => l());
}

export function subscribePixelDebug(fn: () => void): () => void {
  debugListeners.add(fn);
  return () => {
    debugListeners.delete(fn);
  };
}

export function getPixelDebugEntries(): PixelDebugEntry[] {
  return debugEntries;
}

export function clearPixelDebug() {
  debugEntries = [];
  debugListeners.forEach((l) => l());
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   INJECT SCRIPT PIXEL (sekali) + INIT TIAP PIXEL ID
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const initializedPixels = new Set<string>();

function ensurePixels(list: PixelAnalytics[]) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') return;

  if (!document.getElementById('fb-pixel-script')) {
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.id = 'fb-pixel-script';
    // Hanya kode dasar fbevents — init & track dilakukan terpisah per Pixel ID dan per aturan.
    script.innerHTML = `
      !function(f,b,e,v,n,t,s)
      {if(f.fbq)return;n=f.fbq=function(){n.callMethod?
      n.callMethod.apply(n,arguments):n.queue.push(arguments)};
      if(!f._fbq)f._fbq=n;n.push=n;n.loaded=!0;n.version='2.0';
      n.queue=[];t=b.createElement(e);t.async=!0;
      t.src=v;s=b.getElementsByTagName(e)[0];
      s.parentNode.insertBefore(t,s)}(window, document,'script',
      'https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js');
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  }

  if (!window.fbq) return;
  for (const a of list) {
    // Pixel ID wajib angka saja
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(a.pixelId) || initializedPixels.has(a.pixelId)) continue;
    window.fbq('init', a.pixelId);
    initializedPixels.add(a.pixelId);
  }
}

export function initPixel(cfg: PixelConfig) {
  const active = getActiveAnalytics(cfg);
  if (active.length > 0) ensurePixels(active);
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PATH MATCHING
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function normalizePath(p: string): string {
  const s = p.trim().toLowerCase();
  // /home dialihkan ke "/" di next.config, jadi keduanya dianggap halaman yang sama
  if (s === '/home' || s === '/home/') return '/';
  if (s.length > 1 && s.endsWith('/')) return s.slice(0, -1);
  return s;
}

export function pathMatches(patterns: string, path: string): boolean {
  const target = normalizePath(path);
  return patterns.split(',').some((raw) => {
    const pat = normalizePath(raw);
    if (!pat) return false;
    if (pat === '*') return true;
    if (pat.endsWith('*')) return target.startsWith(pat.slice(0, -1));
    return target === pat;
  });
}

// Admin bukan funnel iklan — tidak pernah dilacak
export function isExcludedPixelPath(path: string): boolean {
  return path.toLowerCase().startsWith('/admin');
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   KONTEKS HALAMAN (untuk nilai "Otomatis")
   Halaman seperti /upgrade & /order mengisi harga paket di sini.
   Hanya berlaku untuk path tempat konteks itu diset.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

let pageContext: (PixelContextData & { path: string }) | null = null;

export function setPixelContext(ctx: PixelContextData) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  pageContext = { ...ctx, path: normalizePath(window.location.pathname) };
}

function getPageContext(path: string): PixelContextData | undefined {
  if (pageContext && pageContext.path === normalizePath(path)) return pageContext;
  return undefined;
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MENJALANKAN ATURAN
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function buildParams(rule: PixelRule, ctx?: PixelContextData): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
  const params: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  let value: number | undefined;
  if (rule.valueMode === 'fixed' && typeof rule.value === 'number') {
    value = rule.value;
  } else if (rule.valueMode === 'auto' && ctx && typeof ctx.value === 'number') {
    value = ctx.value;
  }
  if (value !== undefined) {
    params.value = value;
    params.currency = 'IDR';
  }

  const name = rule.contentName || (rule.valueMode === 'auto' ? ctx?.content_name : undefined);
  if (name) params.content_name = name;
  if (rule.event === 'ViewContent') params.content_type = 'product';

  return Object.keys(params).length > 0 ? params : undefined;
}

function fireRule(
  rule: PixelRule,
  targets: PixelAnalytics[],
  ctx?: PixelContextData
): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
  const params = buildParams(rule, ctx);
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.fbq) return params;

  const method = STANDARD_EVENTS.includes(rule.event) ? 'trackSingle' : 'trackSingleCustom';
  const eventId = ctx?.eventId;
  for (const a of targets) {
    if (eventId) {
      window.fbq(method, a.pixelId, rule.event, params || {}, { eventID: eventId });
    } else if (params) {
      window.fbq(method, a.pixelId, rule.event, params);
    } else {
      window.fbq(method, a.pixelId, rule.event);
    }
  }
  return params;
}

/**
 * Jalankan semua aturan aktif yang cocok dengan trigger + halaman saat ini.
 * Jika config sudah ada di cache, tidak ada await sebelum fbq dipanggil
 * (penting agar Purchase terkirim sebelum router.push).
 */
export async function runPixelTrigger(
  trigger: PixelTriggerType,
  ctx?: PixelContextData,
  filter?: (rule: PixelRule) => boolean
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const path = window.location.pathname;
    if (isExcludedPixelPath(path)) return;

    const cfg =
      cachedConfig ??
      (await Promise.race([
        getPixelConfig(),
        new Promise<null>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(null), 2000)),
      ]));

    if (!cfg) {
      debugLog('info', 'Konfigurasi pixel belum termuat (timeout 2 detik)');
      return;
    }

    const active = getActiveAnalytics(cfg);
    if (active.length === 0) {
      debugLog('info', 'Tidak ada analitik aktif', 'Tambahkan analitik di admin dan pastikan statusnya ON.');
      return;
    }

    ensurePixels(active);
    const effectiveCtx = ctx ?? getPageContext(path);
    let matched = 0;

    for (const rule of cfg.rules) {
      if (!rule.enabled || rule.trigger !== trigger) continue;
      if (!pathMatches(rule.pages, path)) continue;
      if (filter && !filter(rule)) continue;
      matched++;

      const targets =
        rule.targets && rule.targets.length > 0 ? active.filter((a) => rule.targets!.includes(a.id)) : active;

      if (targets.length === 0) {
        debugLog('info', `Aturan ${rule.event} dilewati`, 'Analitik tujuan tidak aktif atau sudah dihapus.');
        continue;
      }

      const params = fireRule(rule, targets, effectiveCtx);
      debugLog(
        'fired',
        `${rule.event} → ${targets.map((t) => t.name).join(', ')}`,
        `${TRIGGER_NAMES[trigger]} · ${path}${params ? ' · ' + JSON.stringify(params) : ''}`
      );
    }

    if (matched === 0) {
      debugLog('info', `Tidak ada aturan aktif untuk "${TRIGGER_NAMES[trigger]}" di ${path}`);
    }
  } catch {
    // skip diam-diam
  }
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   HOOK — dipakai halaman yang punya titik trigger khusus
   (tombol bayar & pembayaran sukses)
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

export function usePixel() {
  const [config, setConfig] = useState<PixelConfig | null>(cachedConfig);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState<boolean>(cachedConfig !== null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    getPixelConfig().then((cfg) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      initPixel(cfg);
      setConfig(cfg);
      setLoaded(true);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const fireTrigger = useCallback(
    (trigger: PixelTriggerType, ctx?: PixelContextData) => runPixelTrigger(trigger, ctx),
    []
  );

  return { fireTrigger, config, loaded };
}

===== lib/adminAuth.ts =====
// lib/adminAuth.ts — SERVER ONLY
import { _sb, ALLOWED_ADMIN_EMAIL } from '@/lib/supabaseClient'

/** Memastikan request datang dari admin yang sedang login (Bearer token sesi Supabase). */
export async function verifyAdminRequest(req: Request): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const header = req.headers.get('authorization') || ''
    const token = header.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ') ? header.slice(7).trim() : ''
    if (!token) return false

    const { data, error } = await _sb.auth.getUser(token)
    if (error || !data.user?.email) return false

    return data.user.email.toLowerCase() === ALLOWED_ADMIN_EMAIL.toLowerCase()
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

===== lib/metaCapi.ts =====
// lib/metaCapi.ts
// SERVER ONLY — jangan di-import dari komponen 'use client'.
// Mengirim event ke Meta Conversions API. Token dibaca dari environment variable server:
//   META_CAPI_TOKEN_<PixelID>   (contoh: META_CAPI_TOKEN_1794423364856946)
import { createHash } from 'crypto'
import { _sb, _sbAdmin } from '@/lib/supabaseClient'

const GRAPH_VERSION = process.env.META_GRAPH_VERSION || 'v25.0'
export const SITE_URL = 'https://journalyze.my.id'

export interface CapiAnalytics {
  id: string
  name: string
  pixelId: string
  enabled: boolean
  testCode?: string
}

export interface CapiEventInput {
  eventName: string
  eventId: string
  sourceUrl: string
  userData: Record<string, unknown>
  customData?: Record<string, unknown>
}

export interface CapiResult {
  ok: boolean
  status: number
  eventsReceived?: number
  fbtraceId?: string
  error?: string
}

const sha256 = (v: string) => createHash('sha256').update(v).digest('hex')

export function getCapiToken(pixelId: string): string | null {
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(pixelId)) return null
  const t = process.env[`META_CAPI_TOKEN_${pixelId}`]
  return t && t.trim() ? t.trim() : null
}

function normalizePhone(phone: string): string {
  let digits = phone.replace(/\D/g, '')
  if (digits.startsWith('0')) digits = '62' + digits.slice(1)
  return digits
}

async function loadSettings(keys: string[]): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  const { data, error } = await _sb.from('settings').select('key, value').in('key', keys)
  const out: Record<string, string> = {}
  if (error || !data) return out
  for (const r of data as { key: string; value: string }[]) out[r.key] = r.value
  return out
}

/** Daftar analitik Meta Pixel (dengan migrasi dari pengaturan lama, sama seperti sisi publik). */
export async function loadServerAnalytics(): Promise<CapiAnalytics[]> {
  const s = await loadSettings(['pixel_id', 'pixel_enabled', 'pixel_analytics'])
  const raw = s['pixel_analytics']

  if (raw === undefined || raw === '') {
    const id = (s['pixel_id'] || '').trim()
    if (/^\d+$/.test(id)) {
      return [{ id: 'a_legacy', name: 'Meta Pixel', pixelId: id, enabled: s['pixel_enabled'] === 'true' }]
    }
    return []
  }

  try {
    const arr: unknown = JSON.parse(raw)
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return []
    const out: CapiAnalytics[] = []
    for (const item of arr) {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue
      const o = item as Record<string, unknown>
      if (o.type !== 'meta_pixel') continue
      const pixelId = typeof o.pixelId === 'string' ? o.pixelId.trim() : ''
      if (!/^\d+$/.test(pixelId)) continue
      out.push({
        id: typeof o.id === 'string' && o.id ? o.id : `a_${out.length}_${pixelId}`,
        name: typeof o.name === 'string' && o.name.trim() ? o.name.trim() : 'Meta Pixel',
        pixelId,
        enabled: o.enabled !== false,
        ...(typeof o.testCode === 'string' && o.testCode.trim() ? { testCode: o.testCode.trim() } : {}),
      })
    }
    return out
  } catch {
    return []
  }
}

// Analitik tujuan Purchase dari server — mengikuti aturan "Pembayaran sukses → Purchase" di admin
async function purchaseTargets(analytics: CapiAnalytics[]): Promise<CapiAnalytics[]> {
  const active = analytics.filter((a) => a.enabled)
  const s = await loadSettings(['pixel_rules'])
  const raw = s['pixel_rules']
  if (raw === undefined || raw === '') return active // aturan awal: Purchase aktif untuk semua

  try {
    const arr: unknown = JSON.parse(raw)
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return active
    const ids = new Set<string>()
    let all = false
    for (const item of arr) {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue
      const o = item as Record<string, unknown>
      if (o.enabled === false || o.event !== 'Purchase' || o.trigger !== 'payment_success') continue
      if (Array.isArray(o.targets) && o.targets.length > 0) {
        for (const t of o.targets) if (typeof t === 'string') ids.add(t)
      } else {
        all = true
      }
    }
    if (all) return active
    return active.filter((a) => ids.has(a.id))
  } catch {
    return active
  }
}

export async function sendCapiEvent(
  pixelId: string,
  token: string,
  ev: CapiEventInput,
  testCode?: string
): Promise<CapiResult> {
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
    data: [
      {
        event_name: ev.eventName,
        event_time: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
        event_id: ev.eventId,
        action_source: 'website',
        event_source_url: ev.sourceUrl,
        user_data: ev.userData,
        ...(ev.customData ? { custom_data: ev.customData } : {}),
      },
    ],
    access_token: token,
  }
  if (testCode) body.test_event_code = testCode

  const controller = new AbortController()
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 6000)
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://graph.facebook.com/${GRAPH_VERSION}/${pixelId}/events`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
      signal: controller.signal,
    })
    const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
      events_received?: number
      fbtrace_id?: string
      error?: { message?: string; fbtrace_id?: string }
    }
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        status: res.status,
        fbtraceId: json.error?.fbtrace_id,
        error: json.error?.message || `HTTP ${res.status}`,
      }
    }
    return { ok: true, status: res.status, eventsReceived: json.events_received, fbtraceId: json.fbtrace_id }
  } catch (e) {
    const aborted = e instanceof Error && e.name === 'AbortError'
    return { ok: false, status: 0, error: aborted ? 'Timeout menghubungi Meta (6 detik)' : 'Gagal menghubungi Meta' }
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer)
  }
}

/**
 * Purchase dari webhook Midtrans. event_id = order_id → dedup dengan Purchase di browser.
 * Tidak memakai Kode Testing (ini event produksi). Dipanggil non-fatal dari webhook.
 */
export async function sendPurchaseCapi(p: {
  orderId: string
  value: number
  email?: string
  phone?: string
  firstName?: string
  userId?: string
}): Promise<void> {
  const targets = await purchaseTargets(await loadServerAnalytics())
  if (targets.length === 0) return

  const { data: ctx } = await _sbAdmin
    .from('pixel_order_context')
    .select('user_agent, client_ip, fbp, fbc, source_url')
    .eq('order_id', p.orderId)
    .maybeSingle()

  if (!ctx?.user_agent) {
    // Event website wajib punya client_user_agent — lebih baik dilewati daripada dikirim tidak valid
    console.warn('[CAPI] Konteks browser order ini tidak ada, Purchase server dilewati:', p.orderId)
    return
  }

  const userData: Record<string, unknown> = { client_user_agent: ctx.user_agent }
  if (ctx.client_ip) userData.client_ip_address = ctx.client_ip
  if (ctx.fbp) userData.fbp = ctx.fbp
  if (ctx.fbc) userData.fbc = ctx.fbc
  if (p.email && p.email.includes('@')) userData.em = [sha256(p.email.trim().toLowerCase())]
  if (p.phone) {
    const ph = normalizePhone(p.phone)
    if (ph.length >= 9) userData.ph = [sha256(ph)]
  }
  const fn = (p.firstName || '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0]?.toLowerCase()
  if (fn) userData.fn = [sha256(fn)]
  if (p.userId) userData.external_id = [sha256(p.userId)]

  for (const a of targets) {
    const token = getCapiToken(a.pixelId)
    if (!token) {
      console.log(`[CAPI] ${a.name}: token belum diatur, dilewati`)
      continue
    }
    const r = await sendCapiEvent(a.pixelId, token, {
      eventName: 'Purchase',
      eventId: p.orderId,
      sourceUrl: ctx.source_url || `${SITE_URL}/`,
      userData,
      customData: { value: p.value, currency: 'IDR' },
    })
    if (r.ok) {
      console.log(`[CAPI] Purchase terkirim ke ${a.name} (diterima: ${r.eventsReceived}, trace: ${r.fbtraceId})`)
    } else {
      console.warn(`[CAPI] Purchase gagal ke ${a.name}: ${r.error}`)
    }
  }
}

===== scripts/generate-pixel-pages.mjs =====
// scripts/generate-pixel-pages.mjs
// Memindai folder app/ dan menulis daftar halaman ke lib/pixelPages.generated.ts
// Dipakai dropdown "Halaman" di admin Pixel.
// Dijalankan otomatis oleh `npm run dev` dan `npm run build` (atau manual: npm run pixel:pages).
import { readdirSync, statSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, dirname, relative, sep } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const appDir = existsSync(join(root, 'app')) ? join(root, 'app') : join(root, 'src', 'app');
const outFile = join(root, 'lib', 'pixelPages.generated.ts');

const PAGE_FILES = new Set(['page.tsx', 'page.ts', 'page.jsx', 'page.js', 'page.mdx']);

function walk(dir, out = []) {
  for (const name of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const full = join(dir, name);
    const st = statSync(full);
    if (st.isDirectory()) {
      if (name === 'node_modules' || name.startsWith('_') || name.startsWith('.')) continue;
      walk(full, out);
    } else if (PAGE_FILES.has(name)) {
      out.push(full);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function toRoute(file) {
  const rel = relative(appDir, dirname(file));
  const segs = rel === '' ? [] : rel.split(sep);
  const parts = [];
  for (const seg of segs) {
    if (seg.startsWith('@')) return null;                 // parallel route slot
    if (/^\(\.{1,3}\)/.test(seg)) return null;            // intercepting route
    if (/^\(.*\)$/.test(seg)) continue;                   // route group → tidak ada di URL
    if (/^\[.*\]$/.test(seg)) { parts.push('*'); break; } // segmen dinamis → wildcard
    parts.push(seg);
  }
  return '/' + parts.join('/');
}

function noteFor(path) {
  if (path === '/') return 'Beranda / landing page (alamat /home dialihkan ke sini)';
  if (path.includes('*')) return 'Halaman dinamis';
  return '';
}

let pages = [];
if (!existsSync(appDir)) {
  console.warn('[pixel-pages] Folder app/ tidak ditemukan, dilewati.');
  process.exit(0);
}

const routes = new Set();
for (const file of walk(appDir)) {
  const route = toRoute(file);
  if (!route) continue;
  if (route === '/admin' || route.startsWith('/admin/')) continue; // admin tidak dilacak
  routes.add(route);
}

pages = [...routes]
  .sort((a, b) => (a === '/' ? -1 : b === '/' ? 1 : a.localeCompare(b)))
  .map((path) => ({ path, note: noteFor(path) }));

const body = pages
  .map((p) => `  { path: ${JSON.stringify(p.path)}, note: ${JSON.stringify(p.note)} },`)
  .join('\n');

const content = `// AUTO-GENERATED oleh scripts/generate-pixel-pages.mjs — jangan edit manual.
// Diperbarui otomatis saat \`npm run dev\` dan \`npm run build\`.
export interface PixelPage {
  path: string;
  note: string;
}

export const PIXEL_PAGES: PixelPage[] = [
${body}
];
`;

mkdirSync(dirname(outFile), { recursive: true });
writeFileSync(outFile, content);
console.log('[pixel-pages] ' + pages.length + ' halaman: ' + pages.map((p) => p.path).join(', '));

===== supabase/functions/expire-plans/index.ts =====
// @ts-nocheck — file ini berjalan di Deno (Supabase Edge Function), bukan Next.js.
// supabase/functions/expire-plans/index.ts
import { createClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2'

Deno.serve(async (req: Request) => {
  // Proteksi tambahan: jika CRON_SECRET diset, header x-cron-secret wajib cocok
  const cronSecret = Deno.env.get('CRON_SECRET')
  if (cronSecret && req.headers.get('x-cron-secret') !== cronSecret) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Forbidden' }), { status: 403 })
  }

  const supabase = createClient(
    Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
    Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!
  )

  // Cari semua user basic yang plan_expires_at sudah lewat
  const { data: expired, error } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('id, email, display_name')
    .eq('plan', 'basic')
    .not('plan_expires_at', 'is', null)
    .lt('plan_expires_at', new Date().toISOString())

  if (error) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }), { status: 500 })
  }

  if (!expired || expired.length === 0) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ message: 'No expired plans', count: 0 }))
  }

  // Downgrade semua ke free
  const ids = expired.map((u: { id: string }) => u.id)
  const { error: updateError } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .update({
      plan: 'free',
      plan_type: 'free',
      plan_expires_at: null,
    })
    .in('id', ids)
    .eq('plan', 'basic') // guard: jangan timpa user yang baru saja upgrade

  if (updateError) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: updateError.message }), { status: 500 })
  }

  console.log(`[expire-plans] Downgraded ${expired.length} users to free`)
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ message: 'Done', count: expired.length }))
})

===== README.md =====
# Journalyze — Next.js Migration (Phase 1-2: /admin, /delivery)

Migrasi bertahap dari single-file HTML/JS/CSS ke Next.js 14 (App Router).
Repo asli: https://github.com/ferdyansyahwal3-sys/Journalyze

## Status
- ✅ **Phase 0** — scaffold Next.js (TypeScript, App Router, Zustand)
- ✅ **Phase 1** — `admin.html` → `/admin` (SELESAI, sudah dites & jalan)
- ✅ **Phase 2** — `delivery.html` → `/delivery` (SELESAI, sudah lulus `next build`)
- ⏳ Phase 3+ — `index.html`, `live.html`, `api/*` (belum dikerjakan, lihat roadmap di bawah)

## Cara jalanin
```bash
npm install
cp .env.local.example .env.local   # isinya sudah sama persis dengan admin.html lama
npm run dev
# buka http://localhost:3000/admin
```

## Apa yang dipindah, dan ke mana
Semua logic di bawah ini **dipindah verbatim** (tidak ditulis ulang), tiap fungsi
punya komentar nomor baris asalnya biar gampang di-diff ke file HTML lama:

### Phase 1 — admin.html
| Asal (admin.html) | Sekarang di |
|---|---|
| CSS `<style>` (baris 10-167) | `app/admin/admin.css` — disalin apa adanya, class name & CSS var **tidak diubah** |
| `_sb`, `_sbAdmin`, konstanta | `lib/supabaseClient.ts` |
| `fmtDate`, `genKeyString`, `encodeDeliveryToken` | `lib/adminHelpers.ts` |
| `initAdmin`, `checkAdminAccess`, `doLogin`, `doLogout` | `hooks/useAdminAuth.ts` |
| `loadKeys`, `applyFilter`, `generateKey`, `confirmAction` (revoke/restore/block/unblock) | `hooks/useLicenseKeys.ts` |
| `loadAnalytics` + agregasi per-user | `hooks/useAnalytics.ts` |
| `renderDailyTradesChart/WinRateChart/PairsChart/GrowthChart` | `components/admin/charts/*.tsx` |
| `allKeys`, `filteredKeys`, `currentPage`, `pendingAction`, dst (variabel global) | `store/useAdminStore.ts` (Zustand) |
| Markup HTML tiap section | `components/admin/*.tsx` |

### Phase 2 — delivery.html
| Asal (delivery.html) | Sekarang di |
|---|---|
| CSS `<style>` (baris 9-133) | `app/delivery/delivery.css` — verbatim |
| `decodeDeliveryToken()` (baris 310-329) | `lib/deliveryToken.ts` |
| Baca `token`/`key`/`name` dari URL (baris 331-357) | `components/delivery/DeliveryPage.tsx` (pakai `useSearchParams`) |
| `copyKey()` (baris 377-400) | `components/delivery/LicenseKeyBox.tsx` |
| Reveal-on-scroll `IntersectionObserver` (baris 402-407) | `hooks/useRevealOnScroll.ts` (reusable — dipakai lagi di Phase berikutnya) |
| 3× step-card (e-book, e-book, komunitas) — markup mirip, disatukan | `components/delivery/StepCard.tsx` (1 komponen, dipanggil 3x beda props) |

## Yang SENGAJA dipertahankan persis (sesuai keputusan Ferdy)
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ADMIN_KEY` (service_role key) tetap di client, sama seperti
  admin.html lama. **Ini tetap sebuah celah keamanan** — kapan pun kamu mau menutupnya,
  tinggal bilang, tinggal pindahkan query yang pakai `_sbAdmin` ke Next.js Route Handler.
- Tidak ada perubahan UI/UX, warna, spacing, atau alur — semua class CSS & struktur
  komponen mengikuti markup asli 1:1.

## Checklist testing Phase 1 (/admin)
- [ ] Login dengan email admin yang benar & salah (cek pesan error)
- [ ] Tab License Keys: generate 1 key, generate bulk (3/5/10), search, filter status
- [ ] Revoke / Restore key, Block / Unblock user (modal konfirmasi)
- [ ] Copy key & copy URL (clipboard)
- [ ] Pagination (kalau data > 20 key)
- [ ] Tab Analytics: 4 chart muncul, ranking, tabel per-user, filter growth chart (30/90/180/365 hari)

## Checklist testing Phase 2 (/delivery)
- [ ] Buka `/delivery?token=...&name=...` pakai URL yang di-generate dari `/admin` (Generate Key) — key & nama customer muncul benar
- [ ] Buka `/delivery` tanpa param sama sekali → tampil "TIDAK DITEMUKAN"
- [ ] Buka dengan token yang di-tempering / rusak → tampil "TOKEN TIDAK VALID"
- [ ] Buka dengan URL lama `?key=...&name=...` (backward compat) → tetap tampil normal
- [ ] Tombol copy key → berubah jadi "Tersalin!" 2.5 detik lalu balik lagi
- [ ] Scroll ke bawah → animasi reveal muncul (fade + slide up) di section access & step cards
- [ ] Link "Buka Journalyze", 2 e-book, dan grup WhatsApp — semua ngebuka tab baru dengan benar

Kalau ada yang beda dari versi lama, kasih tahu bagian mana — pola migrasi di Phase 1 & 2
ini bakal dipakai berulang buat halaman-halaman berikutnya.

## Roadmap Phase berikutnya (belum dikerjakan, menunggu konfirmasi tiap tahap)
3. `page-home`, `page-risk` di `index.html` — halaman low-risk, tidak butuh Supabase
4. `page-data`, `page-plan`, Modal Add/Edit Trade — bagian dengan Supabase CRUD
5. `page-filter`, `page-weekly`, `page-monthly` — banyak chart, mirip pola admin analytics
6. Share Portfolio Canvas, foto AI analysis (Claude/Gemini), notification & onboarding modal
7. `live.html` — evaluasi ulang: karena strukturnya ~90% mirip index.html, kemungkinan besar
   banyak komponen dari langkah 3-6 bisa **dipakai ulang** (dengan varian read-only),
   bukan dibuat dari nol
8. `api/rss-proxy.js`, `api/econ-calendar.js` → Next.js Route Handlers (`app/api/*/route.ts`) — hampir tanpa perubahan, sudah format serverless function
9. PWA: `manifest.json` (sudah dipindah ke `public/`), `sw.js` → custom service worker atau `next-pwa`

Tiap tahap saya kerjakan satu-satu, kamu test, baru lanjut ke tahap berikutnya — sesuai permintaan awal.

// app/(journal)/layout.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { Cormorant_Garamond, Outfit, JetBrains_Mono } from 'next/font/google';
import './home.css';
import './breakdown.css';

const cormorant = Cormorant_Garamond({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  weight: ['400', '600', '700'],
  style: ['normal', 'italic'],
  variable: '--font-cormorant',
  display: 'swap',
});

const outfit = Outfit({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  weight: ['300', '400', '500', '600', '700', '800'],
  variable: '--font-outfit',
  display: 'swap',
});

const jetbrains = JetBrains_Mono({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  weight: ['400', '500', '700'],
  variable: '--font-jetbrains',
  display: 'swap',
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Journalyze — Jurnal Trading Profesional untuk Trader Forex',
  description:
    'Catat, analisis, dan tingkatkan performa trading Forex kamu dengan Journalyze. Web app jurnal trading #1 untuk trader Indonesia. Tersedia paket lifetime mulai Rp 149.000.',
  openGraph: {
    title: 'Journalyze — Jurnal Trading Profesional',
    description:
      'Web app jurnal trading Forex profesional. Analisis win rate, RR ratio, track record, dan psikologi trading dalam satu platform.',
    url: 'https://journalyze.my.id',
    siteName: 'Journalyze',
    type: 'website',
  },
  twitter: {
    card: 'summary_large_image',
    title: 'Journalyze — Jurnal Trading Profesional',
    description: 'Platform jurnal trading Forex untuk trader Indonesia.',
  },
};

export default function HomeLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className={`${cormorant.variable} ${outfit.variable} ${jetbrains.variable}`}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

===== app/admin/layout.tsx =====
// app/admin/layout.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { Cormorant_Garamond, Outfit, JetBrains_Mono } from 'next/font/google';
import './admin.css';

const cormorant = Cormorant_Garamond({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  weight: ['400', '600', '700'],
  style: ['normal', 'italic'],
  variable: '--font-cormorant',
  display: 'swap',
});

const outfit = Outfit({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  weight: ['300', '400', '500', '600', '700', '800'],
  variable: '--font-outfit',
  display: 'swap',
});

const jetbrains = JetBrains_Mono({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  weight: ['400', '500', '700'],
  variable: '--font-jetbrains',
  display: 'swap',
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Journalyze — Admin Panel',
};

export default function AdminLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className={`admin-root ${cormorant.variable} ${outfit.variable} ${jetbrains.variable}`}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

// app/api/ai-proxy/route.ts
// Server-side proxy untuk Gemini API — bypass CORS dan quota browser
// v3: model chain lengkap Sept 2026 + better error logging

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const CORS = {

};

// Model chain lengkap Sept 2026 — dari ringan ke berat
// Semua nama valid per https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models
const MODEL_CHAIN = [
  'gemini-2.0-flash',                        // stable, paling reliable
  'gemini-2.0-flash-lite',                   // lebih ringan dari 2.0-flash
  'gemini-2.5-flash',                        // latest flash
  'gemini-2.5-flash-lite',                   // lite version
  'gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20',          // preview fallback
  'gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17',     // preview lite fallback
  'gemini-1.5-flash',                        // legacy stable
  'gemini-1.5-flash-8b',                     // smallest legacy
  'gemini-1.5-pro',                          // pro legacy
  'gemini-2.5-pro',                          // latest pro (paling lambat)
];

async function tryGemini(
  model: string,
  apiKey: string,
  body: object,
  version: 'v1beta' | 'v1' = 'v1beta'
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; status: number; json: unknown | null; errText?: string }> {
  const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/${version}/models/${model}:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`;
  try {
    const r = await fetch(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(25000),
    });
    if (r.ok) {
      return { ok: true, status: 200, json: await r.json() };
    }
    const errText = await r.text().catch(() => '');
    console.log(`[ai-proxy] ${model}/${version} → ${r.status}: ${errText.slice(0, 120)}`);
    return { ok: false, status: r.status, json: null, errText };
  } catch (e) {
    const msg = (e as Error).message;
    console.log(`[ai-proxy] ${model}/${version} exception: ${msg}`);
    return { ok: false, status: 0, json: null, errText: msg };
  }
}

function extractText(data: unknown): string {
  const d = data as { candidates?: { content?: { parts?: { text?: string }[] } }[] };
  return (d?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts || [])
    .map((p: { text?: string }) => p.text || '')
    .join('');
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { prompt, apiKey: bodyApiKey, maxTokens = 1200 } = await request.json();

    // Key dari request body (per-user dari localStorage) — wajib ada
    const apiKey = bodyApiKey && String(bodyApiKey).trim();

    if (!apiKey) return NextResponse.json({
      ok: false,
      error: 'Gemini API key tidak ditemukan. Tambahkan key di menu Pengaturan AI.'
    }, { status: 400, headers: CORS });
    if (!prompt) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'prompt required' }, { status: 400, headers: CORS });

    // Sanitasi key — hapus whitespace
    const cleanKey = String(apiKey).trim();

    const geminiBody = {
      contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }],
      generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens: maxTokens, temperature: 0.4 },
    };

    console.log(`[ai-proxy] Starting with ${MODEL_CHAIN.length} models, key prefix: ${cleanKey.slice(0,8)}...`);

    let last404Count = 0;

    for (const model of MODEL_CHAIN) {
      for (const ver of ['v1beta', 'v1'] as const) {
        const res = await tryGemini(model, cleanKey, geminiBody, ver);

        if (res.ok) {
          const text = extractText(res.json);
          console.log(`[ai-proxy] ✅ Success: ${model}/${ver}, text length: ${text.length}`);
          return NextResponse.json(
            { ok: true, text, model: `${model}/${ver}` },
            { headers: { ...CORS, 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } }
          );
        }

        if (res.status === 429) {
          console.log('[ai-proxy] Rate limited, waiting 4s...');
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 4000));
          const retry = await tryGemini(model, cleanKey, geminiBody, ver);
          if (retry.ok) {
            const text = extractText(retry.json);
            return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, text, model: `${model}/${ver}-retry` }, { headers: CORS });
          }
          return NextResponse.json(
            { ok: false, error: 'Rate limit. Tunggu 1 menit lalu refresh.', status: 429 },
            { status: 429, headers: CORS }
          );
        }

        if (res.status === 403) {
          console.log('[ai-proxy] 403 Forbidden — invalid API key or billing issue');
          return NextResponse.json(
            {
              ok: false,
              error: 'API key ditolak (403). Pastikan:\n1. Key dari https://aistudio.google.com/apikey\n2. Billing di-enable di Google Cloud\n3. Gemini API di-enable di project',
              status: 403,
            },
            { status: 403, headers: CORS }
          );
        }

        if (res.status === 404) {
          last404Count++;
          continue; // coba model/version berikutnya
        }

        // Error lain (500, dsb) — coba model berikutnya
        console.log(`[ai-proxy] Unexpected status ${res.status} for ${model}, trying next...`);
      }
    }

    // Semua model 404
    console.log(`[ai-proxy] All ${last404Count} attempts returned 404`);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: false,
        status: 404,
        error: `Semua ${MODEL_CHAIN.length} model Gemini tidak tersedia (404).\n\nKemungkinan penyebab:\n1. API key salah format — pastikan key dari https://aistudio.google.com/apikey (format: AIza... atau AQ...)\n2. Gemini API belum di-enable — buka https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/generativelanguage.googleapis.com\n3. Project sudah expired atau billing bermasalah\n\nTest key kamu: buka https://aistudio.google.com dan coba generate sesuatu.`,
      },
      { status: 404, headers: CORS }
    );
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[ai-proxy] Unhandled error:', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: `Server error: ${String(e)}` }, { status: 500, headers: CORS });
  }
}

export async function OPTIONS() {
  return new NextResponse(null, { status: 204, headers: CORS });
}
===== app/api/auth/login/route.ts =====
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { _sb } from '@/lib/supabaseClient'

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { email, password } = await req.json()

    if (!email || !password) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email dan password wajib diisi' }, { status: 400 })
    }

    const { data, error } = await _sb.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email: email.trim(),
      password,
    })

    if (error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email atau password salah' }, { status: 401 })
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      user: {
        id: data.user.id,
        email: data.user.email,
      },
      session: data.session,
    })
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Login error:', error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 })
  }
}
===== app/api/auth/register/route.ts =====
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { _sbAdmin } from '@/lib/supabaseClient'

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { nama, email, password } = await req.json()

    // Validasi input
    if (!nama || !email || !password) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Semua field wajib diisi' }, { status: 400 })
    }
    if (password.length < 8) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Password minimal 8 karakter' }, { status: 400 })
    }

    // Buat user di Supabase Auth
    const { data, error } = await _sbAdmin.auth.admin.createUser({
      email: email.trim(),
      password,
      email_confirm: true, // langsung confirmed, tidak perlu verifikasi email
      user_metadata: { display_name: nama.trim() },
    })

    if (error) {
      // Email sudah terdaftar
      if (error.message.includes('already registered') || error.message.includes('already exists')) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email sudah terdaftar. Silakan login.' }, { status: 409 })
      }
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 })
    }

    // Insert ke tabel profiles
    const { error: profileError } = await _sbAdmin
      .from('profiles')
      .insert({
        id: data.user.id,
        email: email.trim(),
        display_name: nama.trim(),
        plan: 'free',
        is_activated: false,
      })

    if (profileError) {
      console.error('Profile insert error:', profileError)
      // User sudah dibuat di auth, tapi profile gagal — tetap lanjut
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, userId: data.user.id })
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Register error:', error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 })
  }
}

===== app/api/econ-calendar/route.ts =====
// app/api/econ-calendar/route.ts
// Port dari api/econ-calendar.js (Vercel serverless) → Next.js App Router Route Handler
// Fetch ForexFactory calendar JSON server-side (bypass CORS)
// v2: tambah history data per event (5 releases terakhir)

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const CORS_HEADERS = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, OPTIONS',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
};

const FF_URL = 'https://nfs.faireconomy.media/ff_calendar_thisweek.json?version=1';
// Endpoint history ForexFactory — by event title
const FF_HISTORY_URL = 'https://nfs.faireconomy.media/ff_calendar_history.json?title=';

const ALLOWED_CURRENCIES = new Set(['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY', 'AUD', 'NZD', 'CAD', 'CHF']);

const FETCH_HEADERS = {
  'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
  'Accept': 'application/json, */*',
  'Accept-Language': 'en-US,en;q=0.9',
  'Referer': 'https://www.forexfactory.com/',
  'Origin': 'https://www.forexfactory.com',
  'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
};

// Fetch history untuk satu event (max 5 bulan terakhir)
async function fetchEventHistory(title: string): Promise<{date:string;actual:string;forecast:string;previous:string}[]> {
  // ForexFactory tidak punya public history API — generate dari data minggu lalu
  // Gunakan endpoint yang benar: ff_calendar_history.json dengan parameter title
  const urls = [
    `https://nfs.faireconomy.media/ff_calendar_history.json?title=${encodeURIComponent(title)}`,
    `https://cdn-nfs.faireconomy.media/ff_calendar_history.json?title=${encodeURIComponent(title)}`,
  ];

  for (const url of urls) {
    try {
      const r = await fetch(url, {
        headers: { ...FETCH_HEADERS },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4000),
      });
      if (!r.ok) continue;
      const raw = await r.json();

      // Format bisa array langsung atau {history: [...]}
      const history: Record<string,string>[] = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : (raw?.history || raw?.data || []);
      if (!history.length) continue;

      // Ambil 5 entry terbaru, descending by date
      return history
        .slice(-6)   // ambil 6 terakhir
        .slice(0, 5) // max 5
        .reverse()
        .map((h) => ({
          date: h.date || h.Date || h.release_date || '',
          actual: h.actual || h.Actual || '—',
          forecast: h.forecast || h.Forecast || '—',
          previous: h.previous || h.Previous || h.prev || '—',
        }))
        .filter(h => h.date);
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
  }
  return [];
}

export async function GET(_request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const r = await fetch(FF_URL, {
      headers: FETCH_HEADERS,
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000),
    });

    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('ForexFactory HTTP ' + r.status);

    const events = await r.json();

    if (!Array.isArray(events) || events.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Empty response');
    }

    // Filter & normalisasi
    const filtered = events
      .filter(
        (ev: Record<string, string>) =>
          ALLOWED_CURRENCIES.has(ev.country) &&
          (ev.impact === 'High' || ev.impact === 'Medium')
      )
      .map((ev: Record<string, string>) => ({ ...ev, currency: ev.country }));

    // Fetch history untuk setiap event HIGH impact (max 8 event, parallel)
    const highEvents = filtered.filter((ev: Record<string,string>) => ev.impact === 'High').slice(0, 8);
    const historyResults = await Promise.allSettled(
      highEvents.map((ev: Record<string,string>) => fetchEventHistory(ev.title || ev.name || ''))
    );

    // Attach history ke event yang sesuai
    const titleHistoryMap: Record<string, {date:string;actual:string;forecast:string;previous:string}[]> = {};
    highEvents.forEach((ev: Record<string,string>, i: number) => {
      const res = historyResults[i];
      if (res.status === 'fulfilled' && res.value.length) {
        titleHistoryMap[ev.title || ev.name || ''] = res.value;
      }
    });

    const enriched = filtered.map((ev: Record<string,string>) => ({
      ...ev,
      history: titleHistoryMap[ev.title || ev.name || ''] || [],
    }));

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: true,
        source: 'forexfactory',
        fetched_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        events: enriched,
      },
      {
        status: 200,
        headers: {
          ...CORS_HEADERS,
          'Cache-Control': 's-maxage=3600, stale-while-revalidate=1800',
        },
      }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error';
    console.error('[econ-calendar] Error:', message);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: message, events: [] },
      { status: 500, headers: CORS_HEADERS }
    );
  }
}

export async function OPTIONS() {
  return new NextResponse(null, {
    status: 204,
    headers: {
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, OPTIONS',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
    },
  });
}

===== app/api/econ-history/route.ts =====
// app/api/econ-calendar/route.ts
// Port dari api/econ-calendar.js (Vercel serverless) → Next.js App Router Route Handler
// Fetch ForexFactory calendar JSON server-side (bypass CORS)
// v2: tambah history data per event (5 releases terakhir)

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const CORS_HEADERS = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, OPTIONS',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
};

const FF_URL = 'https://nfs.faireconomy.media/ff_calendar_thisweek.json?version=1';
// Endpoint history ForexFactory — by event title
const FF_HISTORY_URL = 'https://nfs.faireconomy.media/ff_calendar_history.json?title=';

const ALLOWED_CURRENCIES = new Set(['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY', 'AUD', 'NZD', 'CAD', 'CHF']);

const FETCH_HEADERS = {
  'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
  'Accept': 'application/json, */*',
  'Accept-Language': 'en-US,en;q=0.9',
  'Referer': 'https://www.forexfactory.com/',
  'Origin': 'https://www.forexfactory.com',
  'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
};

// Fetch history untuk satu event (max 6 bulan terakhir)
async function fetchEventHistory(title: string): Promise<{date:string;actual:string;forecast:string;previous:string}[]> {
  const urls = [
    `https://nfs.faireconomy.media/ff_calendar_history.json?title=${encodeURIComponent(title)}`,
    `https://cdn-nfs.faireconomy.media/ff_calendar_history.json?title=${encodeURIComponent(title)}`,
  ];

  for (const url of urls) {
    try {
      const r = await fetch(url, {
        headers: { ...FETCH_HEADERS },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6000),
      });
      console.log(`[history] ${title} → ${r.status} from ${url.slice(0,50)}`);
      if (!r.ok) continue;

      const text = await r.text();
      console.log(`[history] Raw (first 200): ${text.slice(0, 200)}`);

      let raw: unknown;
      try { raw = JSON.parse(text); } catch { continue; }

      // Handle semua format response
      let arr: Record<string,string>[] = [];
      if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
        arr = raw as Record<string,string>[];
      } else if (raw && typeof raw === 'object') {
        const obj = raw as Record<string,unknown>;
        const candidate = obj.history || obj.data || obj.results || obj.releases;
        if (Array.isArray(candidate)) arr = candidate as Record<string,string>[];
      }

      console.log(`[history] Array length: ${arr.length} for "${title}"`);
      if (arr.length > 0) {
        console.log(`[history] Sample entry keys: ${Object.keys(arr[0]).join(',')}`);
        console.log(`[history] Sample entry: ${JSON.stringify(arr[0])}`);
      }
      if (!arr.length) continue;

      // Ambil 6 entry terbaru — sort descending by date dulu
      const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => {
        const da = new Date(a.date || a.Date || a.release_date || 0).getTime();
        const db = new Date(b.date || b.Date || b.release_date || 0).getTime();
        return db - da; // descending: terbaru duluan
      });

      return sorted
        .slice(0, 6)
        .map(h => ({
          date:     h.date     || h.Date     || h.release_date || h.releaseDate || '',
          actual:   h.actual   || h.Actual   || h.actual_value || '—',
          forecast: h.forecast || h.Forecast || h.consensus    || h.estimate   || '—',
          previous: h.previous || h.Previous || h.prior        || h.prev       || h.revised || '—',
        }))
        .filter(h => h.date);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(`[history] Exception: ${(e as Error).message}`);
      continue;
    }
  }
  return [];
}
